welcome.title: Welcome to Rustic
welcome.subtitle: A fast, social launcher for Horizon. A few choices and you are in the game.

microsoft.title: Sign in with Microsoft
microsoft.subtitle: Rustic checks with Microsoft that you own the game. Your password never touches Rustic.
microsoft.notOwnedBody: This Microsoft account does not own the game. Rustic never launches the game without a licence.
microsoft.whyBody: Owning the game is mandatory. Horizon prepares the game files from your own installation, and offline profiles are only unlocked after this check.

rustic.title: Your Rustic account
rustic.subtitle: Optional. The game works without it; you can sign in later from Settings.

friends.title: Friends and parties
friends.body: See who is online and join them in one click.

locker.title: Locker
locker.body: Cosmetics on your player, purely visual.

servers.title: Your servers online
servers.body: A free address and domains for the servers you host.

rustic.signIn: Sign in or create an account
rustic.skipHint: Or press Continue to skip for now.
rustic.age: Rustic accounts are for ages {{min}} and up. Under {{consent}}, a parent must agree to data processing; under 18, purchases need a parent’s approval.

privacy.title: Your privacy choices
privacy.subtitle: Everything is off. Turn on only what you are happy to share; you can change it any time in Settings.

usage.title: Usage analytics
usage.body: Which pages and features are used, without content or identifiers.

performance.title: Performance reports
performance.body: Launch and frame times, to find slow spots.

crash.title: Crash reports
crash.body: Sent automatically when the game or launcher crashes. When off, Rustic asks each time.

privacy.note: We never sell data and never share it for advertising.

game.title: Get the game ready
game.subtitle: Rustic uses the game files from your own installation (or downloads what is missing from Mojang), then prepares them for Horizon.
game.notFoundBody: Rustic will download the game files from Mojang for your account.
game.explain: Missing game files come from Mojang's own servers, nothing from third parties: the prepared files stay on this computer.
game.background: You can continue: preparation goes on in the background.
game.prepareFailed: The game files could not be prepared: {{reason}}

ready.title: You are all set
ready.subtitle: Create your first instance now, or skip and do it later.

tips.play: PLAY is always at the bottom right.
tips.friends: Your friends are on the right; Join takes one click.
tips.servers: Host a server for your friends from the Servers page.
